items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Did they sound like Eddie Connan's band, or did they sound like Turk Martin?

ctx.x: Well, it was kind of a modern Dixman band, I would say. Both Ervin Alcon and Fregassoll played more modern than they usually do.
Did they sound like Eddie Connan's band, or did they sound like Turk Martin?
Well, they didn't sound like any particular band. It's just more modern style in some way.
